fields.text: Top-down square stone wall block for a gothic cathedral arena: a single massive cracked dark-grey stone block with beveled edges and a small brass cross inlay, viewed directly from above, fills the whole frame edge to edge, seamless tile. Dark gothic hand-painted 2D game art, deep black background, dramatic warm rim lighting, no text, no watermark.

Top-down pile of broken cathedral rubble: shattered stone chunks, a snapped column drum and dust, viewed directly from above on a deep black background, a rough heap about as wide as it is tall. Dark gothic hand-painted 2D game art, deep black background, dramatic warm rim lighting, no text, no watermark.

Top-down gothic barricade: a heavy barrier of dark oak beams bound with black iron bands and brass crosses, consecrated war-fence, viewed directly from above on a deep black background, spans the full width of the frame. Dark gothic hand-painted 2D game art, deep black background, dramatic warm rim lighting, no text, no watermark.
